preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)
Contract must have ETH balance (from accumulated fees or direct transfers)

exploit_hint: Become the contract owner (or compromise the current owner), then call setOperationsAddress() to set the operations address to a malicious contract you control. The swapBack() function will send all contract ETH to operationsAddress via a low-level call. Create a malicious contract that receives ETH and transfers it to the attacker. Alternatively, if already owner, directly call withdrawStuckETH() which also uses an uncontrolled low-level call to drain ETH to msg.sender.
